FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about WowTok.
FAQ.a1: WowTok is an AI-powered platform that generates complete TikTok-ready videos from simple text prompts. You choose a theme, write what you want, and AI creates a video with generated scenes, voiceover narration, and captions.
FAQ.q2: How does the AI video generation work?
FAQ.a2: Our pipeline uses multiple specialized AI models: one breaks your script into scenes, another generates visuals for each scene, a third animates them into video clips, and a fourth creates the voiceover. Everything is assembled into a final 9:16 vertical video.
FAQ.q3: How long does it take to generate a video?
FAQ.a3: Most videos are generated in 3-5 minutes depending on length and complexity. You'll see real-time progress updates as each stage completes.
FAQ.q4: What video format do I get?
FAQ.a4: Videos are generated in 9:16 vertical format (1080x1920) — optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You get an MP4 file ready to upload directly.
FAQ.q5: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
FAQ.a5: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your dashboard. You'll keep access until the end of your billing period. No questions asked.
FAQ.q6: Do I own the videos I create?
FAQ.a6: Yes, you have full commercial rights to all videos generated on WowTok. Use them on any platform for any purpose.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for WowTok. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
Privacy.s1Text: We collect the following types of information:
Privacy.s1Item1Text: name, email address, and profile picture (when signing in with Google).
Privacy.s1Item2Text: prompts, narration text, and video preferences you submit to generate videos.
Privacy.s1Item3Text: processed securely by Stripe. We do not store credit card numbers or bank account details.
Privacy.s1Item4Text: pages visited, features used, video generation counts, and general interaction patterns.
Privacy.s1Item5Text: IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies for session management.
Privacy.s2Item1: To provide and operate the Service.
Privacy.s2Item2: To process payments and manage subscriptions.
Privacy.s2Item3: To generate AI videos based on your prompts and preferences.
Privacy.s2Item4: To send transactional emails (account, billing, support).
Privacy.s2Item5: To improve the Service through aggregated, anonymized analytics.
Privacy.s2Item6: To detect and prevent fraud or abuse.
Privacy.s3Text: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only:
Privacy.s3Item1Text: Supabase (authentication and database), Stripe (payments), and AI providers (to process your prompts and generate content).
Privacy.s3Item2Text: to comply with legal obligations, enforce our Terms, or protect rights and safety.
Privacy.s4Text: Your prompts and narration text are sent to third-party AI providers to generate video content. These providers process your data according to their own privacy policies. We do not use your content to train AI models. Generated videos are stored securely and accessible only to your account.
Privacy.s5Text: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption. Account data is hosted on Supabase with row-level security. Media files (generated videos and images) are stored in secure cloud storage. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.
Privacy.s6Item1: Account data is retained while your account is active and for a reasonable period after deletion.
Privacy.s6Item2: Generated videos are retained while your account is active. They may be deleted after account cancellation.
Privacy.s6Item3: Payment records are retained as required by financial regulations.
Privacy.s7Text: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
Privacy.s7Item1: Access, correct, or delete your personal data.
Privacy.s7Item2: Export your data in a portable format.
Privacy.s7Item3: Withdraw consent for optional data processing.
Privacy.s7Item5: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
Privacy.s7Contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at
Privacy.s8Text: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We use a locale preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your language selection. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Privacy.s9Text: The Service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that a child has provided personal information, we will delete it promptly.
Privacy.s10Text: Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for international data transfers.
Privacy.s11Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or through the Service. The "Last updated" date reflects when the policy was last revised.
Privacy.s12Text: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us at
